facts.text: John's favorite character from the Lord of the Rings films is Aragorn, who he admires for his growth and leadership.

evidence.quote: My favorite character is Aragorn, he grows so much throughout the story.
He's a great leader and puts others first - that's why he eventually becomes king.

facts.text: John has a painting in his room that depicts a man with long hair, which he uses as a reminder to stay true and be a leader.

evidence.quote: I have a painting in my room to remind me to stay true and be a leader in everything I do.
[image: a photo of a painting of a man smoking a cigarette]
